title: Astragaloside IV protects against PM2.5-induced spermatocyte injury via the cGAS-STING/Nrf2/HMOX1 axis.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪甲苷IV对PM2.5诱导精子细胞损伤的保护机制，涉及cGAS-STING/Nrf2/HMOX1通路，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Whether PM2.5-induced spermatocyte injury engages the cGAS-STING innate immune pathway remains unknown. This study integrated network pharmacology, GEO transcriptomic profiling (GSE189187), gene set enrichment analysis, molecular docking with positive-control benchmarking, single-cell RNA sequencing, and in vitro validation in GC-2 spermatocyte cells to address this question. Among 35 overlapping candidates between 447 AS-IV putative targets and 102 cGAS-STING/inflammation genes, Hmox1 was the sole gene significantly upregulated by PM2.5 (log(2)FC = 2.15, AUC = 1.000). KEGG analysis identified six enriched innate immunity pathways, with the Cytosolic DNA-sensing pathway at adjusted P = 8.1 x 10(-)(6). Molecular docking demonstrated that AS-IV bound cGAS (-10.2 kcal/mol) and STING (-11.3 kcal/mol) with affinities exceeding known inhibitors G150 (-8.8) and H-151 (-8.6). In GC-2 cells, PM2.5 (200 mug/mL) increased ROS 5.35-fold, elevated apoptosis to 42.83%, and activated cGAS-STING signaling. AS-IV co-treatment restored viability to 83.3%, enhanced proliferation to 37.96%, significantly suppressed cGAS/p-TBK1/p-IRF3, and activated Nrf2/HMOX1 (HMOX1 protein 1.99 +/- 0.05-fold; mRNA 6.44-fold), reducing apoptosis to 18.27%, ROS, and LDH release, and normalizing the Bax/Bcl2 ratio from 5.0 to 2.1. These findings establish that AS-IV protects spermatocytes through coordinated cGAS-STING suppression and Nrf2-dependent HMOX1 activation. Causal necessity of cGAS-STING activation was confirmed by RU.521-mediated pathway blockade, and direct AS-IV binding to cGAS (KD = 0.619 muM) and STING (KD = 0.097 muM) was validated by surface plasmon resonance.
abstract_zh: PM2.5诱导的精母细胞损伤是否涉及cGAS-STING先天免疫通路仍属未知。本研究整合了网络药理学、GEO转录组分析（GSE189187）、基因集富集分析、分子对接及阳性对照基准测试、单细胞RNA测序，以及GC-2精母细胞中的体外验证，以解答此问题。在447个AS-IV推定靶点与102个cGAS-STING/炎症基因之间的35个重叠候选基因中，Hmox1是唯一被PM2.5显著上调的基因（log(2)FC = 2.15，AUC = 1.000）。KEGG分析识别出六条富集的先天免疫通路，其中胞质DNA感知通路调整后P = 8.1 x 10(-)(6)。分子对接显示，AS-IV与cGAS（-10.2 kcal/mol）和STING（-11.3 kcal/mol）的结合亲和力超过已知抑制剂G150（-8.8）和H-151（-8.6）。在GC-2细胞中，PM2.5（200 mug/mL）使ROS增加5.35倍，凋亡率升高至42.83%，并激活cGAS-STING信号通路。AS-IV联合处理将细胞活力恢复至83.3%，增殖率提升至37.96%，显著抑制cGAS/p-TBK1/p-IRF3，并激活Nrf2/HMOX1（HMOX1蛋白1.99 +/- 0.05倍；mRNA 6.44倍），将凋亡率降至18.27%，同时降低ROS和LDH释放，并将Bax/Bcl2比值从5.0正常化至2.1。这些发现表明，AS-IV通过协同抑制cGAS-STING和Nrf2依赖性HMOX1激活来保护精母细胞。cGAS-STING激活的因果必要性通过RU.521介导的通路阻断得到证实，且AS-IV与cGAS（KD = 0.619 muM）和STING（KD = 0.097 muM）的直接结合通过表面等离子体共振得到验证。
